mapper.sql: FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN alert_triggers t ON t.id=n.trigger_id LEFT JOIN quote_events q ON q.id=t.quote_event_id LEFT JOIN market_monitor_deliveries d ON d.id=n.monitor_delivery_id AND d.user_id=n.user_id

SELECT n.id, n.user_id, n.trigger_id, t.rule_id, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.rule_snapshot, '$.stockId')) AS UNSIGNED) AS stock_id, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.rule_snapshot, '$.stockSymbol')),d.symbols) AS stock_symbol, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.rule_snapshot, '$.stockName')),'行情监控') AS stock_name, t.trigger_price, COALESCE(t.event_time,d.event_time) event_time, n.title, n.content, n.status, n.read_at, n.created_at, n.updated_at, CASE WHEN d.id IS NULL THEN 'PRICE_ALERT' ELSE CONCAT('MONITORING_',d.kind) END event_type
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS trigger_id, r.user_id, r.id AS rule_id, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.rule_snapshot, '$.stockId')) AS UNSIGNED) AS stock_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.rule_snapshot, '$.stockSymbol')) AS stock_symbol, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.rule_snapshot, '$.stockName')) AS stock_name, t.trigger_price, t.event_time, t.rule_snapshot, t.trigger_context, q.origin_type FROM alert_triggers t JOIN alert_rules r ON r.id = t.rule_id JOIN quote_events q ON q.id = t.quote_event_id WHERE t.id = #{triggerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, trigger_id, title, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{triggerId}, #{title}, #{content}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE trigger_id = notifications.trigger_id

WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications n LEFT JOIN alert_triggers t ON t.id = n.trigger_id LEFT JOIN quote_events q ON q.id = t.quote_event_id LEFT JOIN market_monitor_deliveries d ON d.id=n.monitor_delivery_id AND d.user_id=n.user_id SET n.status = 'READ', n.read_at = COALESCE(n.read_at, #{readAt}) WHERE n.id = #{notificationId} AND n.user_id = #{userId} AND
